opening.argument: The speaker presents a paid platform through a recruitment-dependent BitClub Network opportunity, expressly tying its value to bringing new members into the program. He says that getting one person into the network can cause the service to pay for itself for the entire year, and explains that sending others generates a $3 commission so that after three or four members, “your thing is free right there.” He further describes people coming on board as the reason the mining pools will grow bigger and bigger. The presentation therefore makes recruitment and team expansion the route to recovering the platform cost and increasing the promoted opportunity, before ending with a direct invitation to contact him for setup. These statements establish a tiered, commission-based recruitment pitch rather than a stand-alone service explanation.
